title: Colored bands, white passengers and Monday night rides
summary: Two Black bands played on one boat, two white bands on the other; Black passengers could come only on Monday nights.

story.theme_name: Race and segregation in the jazz life
story.community_name: Segregation on the road and the bandstand

blocks.x: We had two colored bands on our boat, and they had two white bands on the other boat.
The other boat was the JS. See, the JS. The JS. Yeah.
Were there any colored passengers at all of these things, or?

On Monday nights, the colors used to come on the stairs and say, boys, we have a boat ride every Monday night. But then we played like we want. We had fun, we drank, smoked, we were at hell on Monday night, man. We used to whisper Monday night to come. Yeah. And they used to have a lot of white people to come on to see, because- On the Monday nights. On the Monday nights. But see, the colors couldn't go- Any other night. Any other night. We used to whisper that night for fun. And all the- All the decades and the boundaries used to whisper Monday nights. But- What kind of a way did you go- Mm-hm.
